---
title: "Citing EvoDAG"
---

If EvoDAG is used in a scientific publication, please cite the first paper
below, which is the preferred citation. The second one describes the library
and the third one the earlier system that EvoDAG grew out of.

## The selection heuristics (preferred citation)

Claudia N. Sánchez and Mario Graff. *Selection Heuristics on Semantic Genetic
Programming for Classification Problems.* Evolutionary Computation 30(2),
pp. 253–289, 2022.
[doi:10.1162/evco_a_00297](https://doi.org/10.1162/evco_a_00297)

```bibtex
@article{sanchez_selection_2022,
  title = {Selection Heuristics on Semantic Genetic Programming for Classification Problems},
  author = {S{\'a}nchez, Claudia N. and Graff, Mario},
  journal = {Evolutionary Computation},
  volume = {30},
  number = {2},
  pages = {253--289},
  year = {2022},
  doi = {10.1162/evco_a_00297}
}
```

The page [Selection](selection.qmd) says which of the heuristics of this paper
are in the released code.

## The library

Mario Graff, Eric S. Tellez, Sabino Miranda-Jiménez and Hugo Jair Escalante.
*EvoDAG: A semantic Genetic Programming Python library.* 2016 IEEE
International Autumn Meeting on Power, Electronics and Computing (ROPEC),
pp. 1–6, November 2016.
[doi:10.1109/ROPEC.2016.7830633](https://doi.org/10.1109/ROPEC.2016.7830633)

```bibtex
@inproceedings{graff_evodag:_2016,
  title = {{EvoDAG}: {A} semantic {Genetic} {Programming} {Python} library},
  shorttitle = {{EvoDAG}},
  doi = {10.1109/ROPEC.2016.7830633},
  booktitle = {2016 {IEEE} {International} {Autumn} {Meeting} on {Power}, {Electronics} and {Computing} ({ROPEC})},
  author = {Graff, M. and Tellez, E. S. and Miranda-Jiménez, S. and Escalante, H. J.},
  month = nov,
  year = {2016},
  pages = {1--6}
}
```

## The earlier system

Mario Graff, Eric S. Tellez, Hugo Jair Escalante and Sabino Miranda-Jiménez.
*Semantic Genetic Programming for Sentiment Analysis.* NEO 2015, Studies in
Computational Intelligence, volume 663, pp. 43–65, Springer, 2017.
[doi:10.1007/978-3-319-44003-3_2](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-44003-3_2)

```bibtex
@incollection{graff_semantic_2017,
  series = {Studies in {Computational} {Intelligence}},
  title = {Semantic {Genetic} {Programming} for {Sentiment} {Analysis}},
  isbn = {9783319440026 9783319440033},
  url = {http://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-319-44003-3_2},
  number = {663},
  booktitle = {{NEO} 2015},
  publisher = {Springer International Publishing},
  author = {Graff, Mario and Tellez, Eric S. and Escalante, Hugo Jair and Miranda-Jiménez, Sabino},
  editor = {Schütze, Oliver and Trujillo, Leonardo and Legrand, Pierrick and Maldonado, Yazmin},
  year = {2017},
  note = {DOI: 10.1007/978-3-319-44003-3\_2},
  pages = {43--65}
}
```

## The software

The source code is released under the Apache 2.0 license and lives at
<https://github.com/mgraffg/EvoDAG>. When you report results, say which
version you used (`EvoDAG-train --version`).
